voice: Plain, specific and short. One idea per sentence.
Lead with what changed at their site, never with us.
One ask per message, easy to say no to.
British English. No exclamation marks. No em dashes.
Name the source of every figure.

claims.text: Cut-overs completed inside the planned turnaround on 14 of 15 migration projects since 2021.
Average unplanned downtime fell 31% in the first year after migration at five refineries.
Hot cut-over method keeps units running during the switch.
Certified to IEC 61511 for safety instrumented systems.
Supports controllers from the three main legacy platforms.
Typical migration of one process unit takes 10 to 14 weeks from design freeze.
Operators retrain in under two weeks with the side-by-side console.
Lifecycle cost over 15 years was 22% lower than staying on extended support, in a published peer case.
Continuous methane monitoring integrates with the control system without new cabling.
Remote support from UK and Rotterdam centres, 24 hours a day.
Fixed-price migration assessment in four weeks.
Cyber security certified to IEC 62443-3-3.
Alarm floods reduced by 40% after rationalisation at a gas plant.
Historian migration keeps 20 years of process data.
Over 120 control system migrations delivered in Europe.
Engineering tools convert 85% of legacy logic automatically.
A dedicated safety case manager on every project.
Spare parts guaranteed for 15 years after go-live.
Pilot on one unit before committing to a site-wide plan.
Average payback of 3.2 years on efficiency gains across eight sites.
